description.value: The Super 8 by Wyndham in 100 Mile House is a national-brand motel located in a small hub town on the Cariboo Highway (Highway 97), a key artery for touring cyclists riding the interior of BC. As part of the Super 8 chain, it offers a predictable mid-range motel experience in a town with limited accommodation options. For cyclists doing long days on the Cariboo, it represents a reliable overnight stop in an otherwise sparsely serviced corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content fetched from the Wyndham corporate page is almost entirely navigation boilerplate and generic brand content — no property-specific amenity details (laundry, bike storage, breakfast, etc.) are present, so nearly all amenities remain null. OSM provides internet_access=wlan but per instructions OSM amenity tags cannot be treated as authoritative without website confirmation, so Wi-Fi is also null. The property is clearly a real, operating Super 8 motel with a matching OSM name, address, and phone number.
concerns: Website content is entirely Wyndham corporate boilerplate with no property-specific amenity information; no cycling-relevant details could be confirmed from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel at a confirmed address on a major cycling route through the BC interior. Useful overnight stop for touring cyclists in a low-density corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tags internet_access=wlan but this could not be confirmed from website content per enrichment rules. Callers should contact the property directly to verify bike storage and other cyclist amenities.
